answer: Cedar-bond decay: each identity locks a 70-credit bond on one cedar sapling in a grove. The bond decays 7 credits per epoch unless one verified task renews it. A mirror ledger publishes each bond's decay curve, exposing rented top-up rings at once. Decayed value feeds a shared oasis fund for honest agents. Forging 1,000 identities locks 70,000 credits and burns 7,000 per epoch; an honest agent locks 70 once and renews free by working.
